key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8812
name: call_sequence_return_registers
description: Calls one routine with a parameter loaded from a global variable, then calls the same routine many more times with no arguments. It returns the two initial data registers combined as one 64-bit value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:88CA
name: call_routine_six_times
description: Calls the same routine six times in a row and returns, without touching any data itself.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:88E4
name: copy_words_to_five_buffers
description: Loops sixteen times, copying pairs of 16-bit words from a source block into five separate destination buffers at fixed offsets. The source block is chosen by a parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:893E
name: return_immediately
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. It is an unreached gap in the code that decodes as a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8948
name: call_once_and_return
description: Calls one routine with an argument read from a global variable and returns the two initial data registers combined as one 64-bit value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:89A2
name: call_routine_repeatedly_with_arg
description: Calls one routine once with an argument read from a global variable, then calls the same routine many more times with no arguments. It returns the two initial data registers combined as one 64-bit value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8A3C
name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, performing no data manipulation of its own.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8A4A
name: compute_tile_indices_and_fill
description: Derives two tile coordinates from its parameters, offsets them by two global values and clamps them to fixed limits, then stores the results in globals. It then calls another routine once for every cell in a nine-by-eighteen grid.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8B04
name: decode_tile_bits
description: Reads five table pointers from a global, then for each of eight blocks gathers one flag bit per source byte into five 16-bit words. Each word is written to two rows of its own destination table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8B9C
name: copy_tile_words
description: Copies eight groups of four 16-bit words from a source table into a destination table at a stride computed from its parameters. The source and destination bases come from global pointers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8BEC
name: compute_tile_index
description: Offsets two coordinate inputs by global origin values, wraps each into a fixed range, and packs their low bits with a table lookup into one 16-bit index. It then adds a global base offset to the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8C58
name: fill_tile_buffer
description: Fills a buffer of nineteen rows by six words, each taking a byte from a lookup table indexed by offset coordinates. It then does one final table lookup, adds 256 when a global flag exceeds seven, and stores the result in a global.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8D1C
name: copy_decompressed_bytes
description: Copies bytes from a global source pointer to a destination, expanding negative control bytes into repeated runs when a mode flag is set. Otherwise it copies a fixed count of raw bytes, then stores the advanced source pointer back into globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8D98
name: scale_value_by_table
description: When the table index is below eight, halves a scaled value taken from a global lookup table and adds it to the first argument, keeping the low fifteen bits. Otherwise it returns the first argument unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8DC2
name: scale_value_with_sign
description: When the table index is below eight, scales the third argument by a global table value and adds it to the first argument. The top bit of the first argument is preserved, and the result is masked to fifteen bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8DF4
name: copy_bit14_to_bit15
description: Copies bit 14 of its argument into bit 15, setting bit 15 when bit 14 is set and clearing it otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E04
name: clear_top_bit_of_word
description: Returns the 16-bit value in the data register with its top bit cleared.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E0A
name: step_stored_coordinates_toward_target
description: Compares two position arguments with stored globals and moves each stored value by one step when the difference is inside a band. Outside the band it snaps the stored value to a fixed offset from the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E42
name: step_stored_coordinates_from_registers
description: Reads two offset values from registers and moves two stored globals toward them, using the same banded step and snap rules as its stack-argument counterpart. The results are written back to the globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E52
name: nudge_stored_coordinates_by_one
description: Adjusts two stored globals by one step each when their differences from register inputs exceed fixed thresholds. It has no snap branch, so the stored values never jump to a new position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E5E
name: bump_x_and_step_y
description: Adds one to a stored value when a register input is above a threshold. It also moves a second stored value by one step within a band, and outside that band snaps it to a fixed offset from another register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E78
name: step_stored_y_coordinate
description: Moves a stored value by one step toward a register input when that input lies outside a small band. Beyond a larger band it snaps the stored value to a fixed offset from a second register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E88
name: nudge_stored_y_coordinate
description: Adds or subtracts one from a stored value depending on which side of a small threshold a register input lies.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8E94
name: increment_counter_if_large
description: Adds one to a stored short value when the input word is greater than ten, and does nothing otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8EAA
name: handle_error_message
description: When its argument is not two, makes three calls: two with constant arguments and one passing the argument back with the value two. The routine also references the text ERROR.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8EE2
name: classify_value_into_range_index
description: Looks up a byte in a table indexed by the argument, then overrides it with a small index when the argument falls inside a chain of ranges. Returns that index combined with the second data register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8F2E
name: decode_joystick_direction_index
description: Reads the joystick port direction bits and maps them through a lookup table to a direction index, or derives the index from a stored position when a mode flag is set. When the index changes it stores the new value and calls another routine with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8F42
name: select_direction_index_and_notify
description: Chooses a direction index from the joystick port bits through a lookup table, or from a stored position when a mode flag is set. A changed index is stored and passed to another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8F94
name: read_joystick_direction_index
description: Reads the joystick port direction bits, maps them through a lookup table to a direction index, and updates a stored flag and countdown. When the index changes, it stores it and calls another routine with the new value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8FE6
name: decrement_index_and_notify_change
description: Subtracts twenty from a stored value, forcing it to nine and resetting a flag when the result falls outside zero to nine. If the resulting index differs from the stored one, it stores the new index and calls another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:8FFA
name: reset_index_to_nine
description: Clears a stored flag word, then sets a stored index to nine and calls another routine with nine, but only when the index was not already nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9018
name: sample_pixel_from_map_2
description: Calls another routine and, if its short result is not one and is below ten, calls it again. A second result that is not one and is below eight becomes zero, and otherwise the second result is returned.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9054
name: invert_and_combine_five_planes
description: Walks a rectangle of 16-bit words and stores, at each position, the inverted AND of five source planes. The planes are spaced at equal intervals in the source buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:90E6
name: setup_blitter_copy
description: Waits for the blitter through the system library, then programs four blitter jobs in a loop. Each job gets a copy-mode control word, full-width masks, and source and destination addresses taken from tables indexed by the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9176
name: set_blitter_regs
description: Writes a fixed control word and clears the modulo and shift registers of the blitter. It then stores two parameters into the destination pointer and size registers and returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:91A0
name: configure_blitter_mask_entries
description: Waits for the blitter through the system library, then programs four blitter entries. Each entry gets first and last word masks derived from a global shift value, along with source, destination and modulo values from globals and tables.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:925A
name: configure_blitter_single_job
description: If the blitter is busy, waits for it through the system library. It then programs one blitter job with a shift-based control word, full masks, and source, destination and size values from globals and a table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:92E4
name: setup_blitter_loop
description: Waits for the blitter through the system library when it is busy, then programs four blitter jobs in a loop. Each job uses a fixed control word, full-width masks, and addresses offset from a parameter and a table entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9364
name: setup_blitter_loop_alt
description: Waits for the blitter through the system library when it is busy, then programs four blitter jobs in a loop. The parameter and table values are written to the opposite pointer registers from the usual layout.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:93E8
name: call_indirect_jump_target
description: Makes an indirect call through a code pointer at a fixed offset from a base register, because the jump table could not be recovered. It does nothing else and returns afterward.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:94C6
name: dispatch_indirect_call_slot
description: Makes an indirect call through a code pointer at a fixed offset from the base register, because the jump table could not be recovered. It returns afterward without other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9BC0
name: compute_direction_toward_target
description: Computes signed x and y distances between a record and a target, with limits that depend on a mode argument. It maps the sign pattern through a lookup table to a direction and stores it in the record; a lookup result of nine instead sets a fixed state byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9BCA
name: steer_direction_toward_target
description: Computes signed x and y distances between a record and a target, applying mode-dependent limits and sign handling. It looks up a direction from the sign pattern, flips it on one bit of a called routine's result, and stores it in the record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9C06
name: steer_direction_from_offsets
description: Takes x and y offsets from registers, negates the x offset, and derives a direction from their signs and magnitudes. It stores the direction in a record and sets a state byte to twelve unless the mode is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9C14
name: steer_direction_with_mode_offsets
description: Derives a direction from register offsets using mode-dependent comparisons on their magnitudes. It writes the result into a record, setting a state byte to twelve unless the mode is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9C7E
name: store_adjusted_direction_index
description: Calls another routine and negates a direction value when one bit of its result is clear. It stores the sum of that value and a second value, masked to three bits, into a record, and sets a state byte to twelve unless the mode is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9C8C
name: store_direction_difference
description: Stores the difference of two register values, masked to three bits, into a byte of a record. It sets a second byte of the record to twelve unless the mode is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9CA8
name: countdown_dispatch_with_fallback
description: When a state byte is below four and one of two table entries matches, calls a routine with a fixed code and stops. Otherwise it subtracts an offset from a stored counter clamped at zero, calls routines through four branches, and makes conditional follow-up calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9D0E
name: subtract_offset_and_dispatch
description: Checks a state byte, then subtracts a register offset from a stored counter clamped at zero. It calls routines with offset-based arguments chosen by four branches, followed by conditional follow-up calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9D44
name: subtract_offset_and_dispatch_group
description: Subtracts a register offset from a stored counter clamped at zero, then calls routines with offset-based arguments chosen by four branches. Conditional follow-up calls depend on two state bytes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9D98
name: dispatch_three_way_branch
description: Calls one of three routines with offset-based arguments, chosen by two register values. It then makes conditional follow-up calls based on a state byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9DBC
name: dispatch_two_way_branch
description: Calls one of two routines with offset-based arguments, chosen by a register value. It then makes conditional follow-up calls based on a state byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9DDA
name: dispatch_fixed_branch_and_notify
description: Always calls one routine with a fixed code and an offset-based argument. It then makes conditional follow-up calls based on a state byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9E4E
name: count_matching_records_and_notify
description: Counts records of one type whose sub-type is fifteen or five, then reports the counts through a routine when a stored value falls in a range. A final conditional call follows.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9E5E
name: tally_typed_records_and_report
description: Walks all records and counts those of one type with sub-type fifteen and those with sub-type five. It reports the counts through a routine when a stored value falls in a range.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9E74
name: tally_subtype_records_and_report
description: Walks records counting those whose sub-type byte is fifteen and those whose sub-type byte is five, then reports the counts when a stored value is positive and within a range. The walk ends at the record count.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9E8C
name: tally_mixed_records_and_report
description: Counts records whose sub-type is five and, for records of one type, those whose sub-type is fifteen. It then reports the counts through a routine when a stored value falls in a range.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9EB8
name: display_outcome_text_by_counts
description: Displays a fixed text message when a stored value is below five and the first count is non-zero. Otherwise it displays messages for non-zero counts when a stored value is below fifty, then makes a conditional follow-up call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9ED0
name: display_battle_result_message
description: When a stored value is below fifty, displays one message for each non-zero count, with a numeric display call between them. It finishes with a conditional follow-up call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9F76
name: detect_nearby_record_collision
description: Returns a nonzero code when another suitable record lies within a small rectangle around a given point. It first checks the point itself, then skips the tested record and records of two excluded kinds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9FE4
name: detect_actor_proximity_collision
description: Scans records from index zero, skipping the actor's own index, index one, and records of two excluded kinds. Returns a nonzero code when one lies within a small rectangle around the actor's stored position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:9FEA
name: detect_actor_proximity_from_index
description: Scans records starting from an index passed in a register, skipping the actor's own index, index one, and records of two excluded kinds. Returns a nonzero code when one lies within a small rectangle around the actor's stored position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A08E
name: scan_for_nearby_record_match
description: Walks the record list from an index, skipping the actor's own index, index one, and records of two excluded kinds. Returns a nonzero code for the first record within a small bounding box of the actor, or zero when none is found.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A0A2
name: find_closest_record_index
description: Scans records from index one, measuring each with a distance routine and keeping the smallest value. It stores the index of the closest record in a global and returns that smallest distance.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A0B2
name: track_minimum_distance_in_record
description: Scans indices from a start value, measuring each through a distance routine and keeping the smallest result in a field of the given record. It stores the matching index in a global and returns the final minimum.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A116
name: measure_offset_with_diagonal_check
description: Measures the absolute x and y differences between two positions. When the two differences are within a factor of two of each other it returns the result of a further routine, and otherwise it returns the x difference.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A194
name: call_pair_when_within_double
description: Calls two routines in sequence when the first register value is at most twice the second. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A1A0
name: call_two_routines_sequentially
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, passing no arguments of its own.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A1B2
name: try_move_record_to_position
description: Computes two candidate coordinates for a record through two indirect calls. If a validity check on them passes, it stores them as the record's new position and returns true.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A240
name: store_record_position_pair
description: Writes two register values into the position fields of the record selected by a field of the current record, then returns one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A264
name: draw_indexed_frame_at_offsets
description: Reads four bytes from a table indexed by the argument, then issues a call with fixed size arguments and a position from a global pointer. For arguments below nine it issues a second call at an offset position using the same bytes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A33C
name: fill_tile_map_entries
description: Chooses a base value from a global mode setting and clamps a level argument to the range zero to one hundred, flooring it or raising it to twenty-five depending on a flag. It then fills thirty-two table entries from routine calls, adjusts them by level in one band, and passes the table to another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A542
name: randomize_tile_map
description: Repeats thirty-two times: fills a table of thirty-one words with values from a routine called with an upper bound of four thousand ninety-five, then passes the table to another routine and calls a third routine with one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A59E
name: process_next_queued_event
description: When the event queue is not empty, reads the next queued code, advances the queue index circularly, and dispatches on that code. Each case draws messages or numbers using fixed coordinates and values from globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A5BC
name: dispatch_next_queued_code
description: Reads the next queued code, advances the queue index circularly, and dispatches on that code. Each case draws messages or numbers using fixed coordinates and values from globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A7C4
name: dispatch_event_code_from_register
description: Dispatches on an event code held in a data register, drawing messages or numbers through fixed-argument calls for each case. Unknown codes do nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A844
name: store_input_byte
description: Stores the byte argument into a circular queue of thirty-two entries unless the queue is full. It advances the write index and returns the two input registers combined.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A872
name: print_zero_terminated_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, passes fixed layout values and a text pointer to one routine, then passes the string with its length to another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A88A
name: initialize_display_setup
description: Makes three setup calls in order: one with a global pointer and six layout constants, one with two small constants, and one with no arguments.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A8CC
name: pass_string_and_length
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and passes it to one routine together with its length.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A8E4
name: self_recursive_call
description: Calls itself with no arguments and no other work, so it would never return. The body is only a call instruction followed by a return.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A8F6
name: wrap_text_into_lines
description: Copies a text string into a line buffer, wrapping lines at about thirty-eight characters. A percent sign is replaced by a string from a table chosen by a global index, and each finished line is passed to another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A916
name: wrap_text_with_line_flush
description: A variant of the text wrapper that copies characters into a line buffer, expands percent signs from a table, and flushes each finished line through another routine once it passes a width near thirty-eight characters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A950
name: resume_text_wrapping_loop
description: Resumes the text wrapping loop partway through a line, handling any pending percent-sign expansion before copying characters into the line buffer. Full lines are flushed through another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A982
name: continue_text_wrapping
description: Advances the line-wrapping state by one character and copies characters into the line buffer. Full lines are flushed through another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A984
name: append_text_char_and_wrap
description: Writes the current character into the output buffer, then advances the wrapping loop. Full lines are flushed through another routine, and the loop is shared with other text entry points.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A9CA
name: terminate_and_flush_text_line
description: Ends the current output line with a zero byte, passes it to another routine, and resets the line counter. Then it continues copying characters, expanding percent signs and flushing lines at the width limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A9F4
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:A9FC
name: skip_strings_then_wrap_text
description: Advances past a count of zero-terminated strings given as an argument, then copies the following text into a line buffer. Percent signs are expanded and completed lines are flushed through another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AA06
name: skip_strings_wrap_second_block
description: Like its counterpart, skips a count of zero-terminated strings and wraps the following text, but it reads from a different text block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AA10
name: wrap_text_after_skipping
description: Skips a given number of zero-terminated strings from a text pointer argument, then copies the remaining text into a line buffer. Percent signs are expanded and completed lines are flushed through another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AA2A
name: call_other_routine_four_times
description: Calls one other routine four times in succession. The arguments are a table entry chosen by a global index, a global pointer, the parameter, and the global pointer again.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AA7E
name: call_other_routine_three_times
description: Calls one routine three times, passing in turn a table entry chosen by a global index, a global pointer, and the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AABA
name: call_other_routine_once
description: Calls one routine once with an argument read from a table entry chosen by a global index.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AADA
name: initialize_buffer_and_state_fields
description: Points a global pointer at a buffer and copies a value through an indirect pointer into another global. It then makes three indirect calls on that buffer, sets a global word to a constant, calls a routine, and stores a constant byte in a global.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AB44
name: initialize_tile_and_flag
description: Calls one routine, points a global pointer at a fixed buffer, and writes a constant word to a global. It then calls another routine and stores a constant byte in a global flag.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AB66
name: loop_decrementing_tile_fill
description: Loops over counter values from one hundred down to zero in steps of five. Each pass calls one routine with the counter and a buffer, then makes an indirect call with one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AB98
name: loop_incrementing_tile_fill
description: Loops over counter values from zero up to one hundred in steps of five. Each pass calls one routine with the counter and a buffer, then makes an indirect call with one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:ABCE
name: clear_two_word_fields
description: Stores zero into two 16-bit fields of a record reached through a global pointer, then calls another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:ABEE
name: copy_and_prepare_structures
description: Copies one global pointer into another and calls a routine several times with constant and table-derived arguments. It stores a word from globals and a pointer, then makes final calls using values read from tables.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AC88
name: populate_struct_from_table
description: Reads several values through an indirect handler and stores a doubled short and a pointer into global arrays. It copies three bytes from a table indexed by the parameter into three 16-bit globals, then conditionally invokes another routine and accumulates a running offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:ADF8
name: copy_struct_and_update_state
description: Points a global at one entry of a record array selected by an argument, calling a handler first if its state field equals two. It copies fourteen longwords from a saved template into the record, sets position fields from shifted arguments and a state value of two, then calls another routine with the record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AE7A
name: copy_block_and_invoke_handler
description: Copies fourteen longwords from a source pointed to by a global into a local buffer, clears a longword and sets a word to nine in globals, then calls a handler with the buffer's address.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AEA6
name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, performing no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AEB2
name: call_with_indexed_global_args
description: Makes an indirect call with a fixed buffer address and clears a 16-bit global. It then calls another routine with five arguments, which are pointer and short values read from global arrays at a stride indexed by the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AF2C
name: conditional_display_update
description: Calls an indirect check on the current record when its state field equals two. If that check returns zero it returns early, otherwise it calls another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AF52
name: read_chunked_data_offsets
description: Opens a named file through a handler, then reads four-byte size headers and the data each describes into a buffer, recording each chunk's offset in a table. It stops after twenty-eight chunks or when a size would exceed a limit, then closes the file.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:AFFE
name: setup_display_area_and_draw
description: When a mode flag is clear, calls a routine with a fixed value and configures a 320 by 200 display area from fixed arguments. It then makes two indirect calls using the parameters, and if a following check returns zero, it makes two more calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B08C
name: loop_over_table_and_blit
description: Loops over twenty-two table entries, copying bitmap rectangles through an indirect routine with positions derived from the table values. Entries below eleven draw a column-by-column strip, while higher entries draw one or more fixed rectangles, and each entry can trigger an indirect call with its value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B350
name: check_key_and_set_flag
description: Calls a handler to obtain a value, stores whether it equals thirty-two into a global flag byte, and returns that boolean.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B372
name: relocate_buffer_above_threshold
description: When the pointer argument exceeds a fixed address threshold, allocates a new buffer through a system call and copies the given number of bytes into it. Otherwise it returns the original pointer unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B3B8
name: compute_orientation_flags_and_draw
description: Computes two signed cross products from four points derived from a parameter record and a global offset table, then sets a flag for each result that is non-negative. When a temporary area is available, it draws the outline through several routine calls and restores saved globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B6FA
name: set_state_and_call_tables
description: Writes a constant two to a global state word, makes two calls with arguments taken from global tables indexed by a counter, and copies the state word into another global when it exceeds three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B75C
name: store_entry_from_table
description: Copies the x coordinate of a table entry chosen by a parameter into a global word, and its y coordinate plus ten into another. It also stores a byte argument and sets a constant byte flag.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B79E
name: set_entry_flag_or_mark
description: Looks up an index through a handler and checks a flag bit in a table of records to choose an entry. If the entry's byte is fifteen it is replaced with twenty-nine, otherwise the second argument is stored into the entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B7E6
name: store_or_mark_entry_byte
description: Adds a handler-supplied index to a table base chosen by a global index. If the byte there is fifteen it is replaced with twenty-nine, otherwise the register byte is stored into it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B814
name: store_byte_to_offset
description: Writes the low byte of a data register into the byte five positions past the address register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B820
name: spawn_entries_and_scan_list
description: Resets two global flags, and on the first pass for a given state spawns ten entries at random positions with types taken from a table. It then walks a list of entries, moving those inside a screen window into the active table and invoking a routine on matching kinds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B870
name: spawn_always_and_scan_list
description: Always spawns ten entries at random positions with types taken from a table, then sets a global state word. It walks the entry list, moving entries inside a screen window into the active table and invoking a routine for matching kinds. The listing is cut off partway through.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:B97A
name: scan_entries_into_active_table
description: Walks a list of entries, checking each against a window around a reference position. Entries in range and of qualifying kinds are copied into the active table, and matching entries whose kind changes trigger a notification routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BA7A
name: advance_entry_and_test_window
description: Advances the entry pointer and counter, stopping when the counter runs out or the active table is full. Each entry's offset from a reference position is computed and passed to the window test, with kinds three and four going straight to it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BA7E
name: update_matching_entries_in_window
description: Checks each entry against a window around the reference position. Kinds three and four are copied into the active table unless an identical entry is already present, and other kinds are appended with a marker. The walk ends when the counter or table runs out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BB2A
name: append_window_entry_and_advance
description: Fills a new active-table record for a kind-three or kind-four entry that does not match an existing one, then advances the walk. Its position is copied into the record, and the walk ends when the counter or table runs out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BB9A
name: store_window_entry_and_advance
description: Finishes an active-table record for a window entry by setting its kind to a fixed value and copying its position, then advances the walk. The walk ends when the counter or table runs out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BBD4
name: append_plain_entry_and_advance
description: Fills a new active-table record for an entry of a kind other than three or four, copying its position and flags, then advances the walk. The walk ends when the counter or table runs out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BC46
name: store_entry_kind_and_advance
description: Sets the kind byte of a new active-table record to one or zero depending on whether the source kind is five, copies its position, and advances the walk through the entry list. The walk ends when the counter or table runs out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BC5C
name: fill_entry_record_and_advance
description: Fills an active-table record for an entry whose kind is not three or four, setting its kind from a flag, then advances the walk through the entry list. The walk ends when the counter or table runs out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BC9E
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BCD2
name: read_typed_text_and_match
description: Shows a prompt and reads keystrokes into a small buffer, accepting printable characters up to nine and handling backspace until return is pressed. It then compares the typed text with stored entries, clears a matched entry, and repeats; it returns one after three matches and zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BD74
name: continue_typed_text_matching
description: Continues the typed-text matching loop, accepting printable characters into the buffer until return is pressed. On return it compares the text with a stored entry, clearing the entry on a match and returning one after three successes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BD84
name: handle_typed_key_for_match
description: Appends a printable character to the typed text buffer when there is room, then reads further keystrokes, handling backspace and return. On return it compares the text with a stored entry and returns one after three successful matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BDB4
name: compare_typed_text_and_advance
description: Compares the typed text with the current stored entry, clearing it on a match and selecting the next entry. It then reads keystrokes into the buffer and returns one after three matches or zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BDD6
name: compare_entry_against_typed_text
description: Compares a stored entry string with the typed buffer character by character, returning zero on a mismatch. A match clears the entry, selects the next one, and continues the keystroke loop.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BDD8
name: clear_matched_entry_and_loop
description: Clears a matched entry, advances the match count, and selects a new entry before returning to the keystroke loop. It returns one after three matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BDF8
name: call_library_cleanup_sequence
description: Calls a fixed sequence of library routines through the system base and through a pointer loaded from a global, reusing the same two offsets on each pointer. It takes no arguments and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BE5C
name: store_and_dispatch_result
description: Calls another routine with two arguments and stores the result in a global. When the result is non-zero it passes it to another routine, and it returns the stored value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BE8A
name: store_result_with_table_check
description: Calls a routine with a global pointer and a fixed negative argument, storing the result in a global. When the result is non-zero it looks up a value through two tables, makes an extra call unless that value matches a fixed code, then passes the result to another routine and returns it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BEE6
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains an instruction the decompiler could not decode, so the routine only halts. It is not a real routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BEEA
name: poll_flag_with_timeout
description: Polls a flag byte up to 300 times, calling a routine with a delay argument of five between checks. When the flag is set it clears it and returns one, or returns zero if it never appears.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BEF4
name: wait_flag_with_delay_loop
description: Repeatedly checks a flag byte with a short delay call between checks, up to 300 times. It clears the flag and returns one when it is found, otherwise it returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BF04
name: wait_for_flag_then_clear
description: Calls a delay routine repeatedly until a flag byte is set, giving up after 300 checks. It clears the flag and returns one when set, or zero on timeout.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BF1E
name: transfer_state_blocks_with_file
description: Builds a file name from a slot letter and opens one of two named files. When the open succeeds it copies a series of state blocks of fixed lengths to or from the file, then closes it and returns a result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BF4E
name: select_slot_and_transfer_state
description: Waits for a slot choice from input, builds a file name from it, and opens the matching file. When the open succeeds it transfers the same sequence of state blocks, then resets some state fields and closes the file.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BF7A
name: select_slot_report_disk_errors
description: Repeats the slot choice and file transfer sequence, and references text for an aborted operation and a request to insert a writable disk. It returns to the display once the sequence finishes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BF9A
name: poll_slot_choice_and_transfer
description: Polls for a slot choice from input, and on a choice builds a file name, opens the file, and transfers the state blocks. It returns to the display when the transfer completes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BF9C
name: transfer_slot_blocks_and_close
description: Builds a file name from a slot letter, opens the matching file, and transfers the state blocks through it. It then waits for an input event, resets state fields, and calls a routine with the display handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:BFC6
name: transfer_state_blocks_fixed_file
description: Opens one fixed named file and transfers the state blocks through it. It then waits for an input event, resets state fields, and calls a routine with the display handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C0A6
name: report_save_failure_and_finish
description: Shows a message through a routine when the transfer result is non-zero, including text for a failed save. It then waits for an input event, resets state fields, and calls a routine with the display handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C0C6
name: report_load_failure_and_finish
description: Displays a load-failure message, waits for an input event, then resets state fields and calls a routine with the display handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C0F4
name: prompt_game_disk_and_wait
description: Displays a prompt asking for the game disk, waits until an input event arrives, then resets state fields and calls a routine with the display handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C104
name: initialize_display_state
description: When a flag byte is clear, resets several globals to zero and calls routines with constant and address arguments. It then makes an indirect call using two global values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C214
name: dispatch_flagged_call_with_args
description: Calls a routine through a handler pointer or directly, depending on a flag, passing two arguments. If the returned value is negative it calls another routine to record the failure.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C238
name: call_handler_and_check_result
description: Calls a handler through a global pointer with two arguments and stores the returned word. If that word is negative it calls another routine and stores its long result in a global.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C262
name: write_bounds_to_table
description: Writes four 16-bit values into a table entry selected by the first argument. The second and third arguments are each offset by fixed amounts to form a pair of corners.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C2BC
name: update_display_state
description: Refreshes display state through a series of routine and indirect calls, then updates a counter and a global offset. It finishes by adding three to a run of table bytes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C3E4
name: run_timed_buffer_fill_loop
description: Makes setup calls, then runs a timed loop of twenty-five steps. Each step fills a buffer from a source table offset by the step number, chooses two values, sends the buffer through a routine, and pauses.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C4A4
name: continue_timed_buffer_fill_loop
description: Continues the timed loop of buffer fills, refilling a 28-entry buffer from a source table offset by the step number and sending it through a routine at each step. The loop pauses between steps and restores a fixed buffer at the end.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C4D0
name: restart_timed_buffer_fill_loop
description: Restarts the timed buffer loop from a fresh pair of values, refilling the buffer from the source table at each step and pausing between steps. It restores a fixed buffer when the steps run out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C560
name: return_conditional_size
description: Returns ten when a byte at the argument's offset in a global block is non-zero, and eight otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C572
name: compute_and_draw_position
description: Computes coordinates from a global position and a flag-dependent offset, then passes them to a routine. Under a second condition it uses fixed coordinates instead, and it returns the call's result, or the low bits of a global flag word when the call is skipped.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C586
name: draw_default_position_or_fixed
description: Returns the low bits of a global flag word unless those bits are zero or a byte exceeds a threshold. In that case it calls a routine with coordinates from a global position, or fixed coordinates when a counter is eight or more.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C5DA
name: call_fill_tile_map
description: Calls one routine with three constant values of one hundred, the constant one, and a fixed buffer address, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C5FC
name: dispatch_entity_action_by_code
description: Looks up an entity record and updates its fields for the requested action code. Depending on the code, it calls a movement or drawing routine with the entity's position, consults another routine's result, or sets a state byte to a fixed value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C61C
name: dispatch_entity_action_from_register
description: Handles the same action codes as the entity dispatcher, but takes the code from a register and looks up the entity record without setting its position fields first.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C64E
name: apply_entity_action_fragment
description: A fragment of an entity action dispatcher with several branches removed as unreachable. It handles action codes eight, four and two by setting state bytes, comparing an identifier, and calling routines for distance-based cases.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C680
name: dispatch_entity_action_with_flag
description: Applies the action-code updates for an entity, with a flag register deciding whether each action fires. Code eight compares distances and may set a state byte, code four stores a masked routine result, and code two checks an identifier before calling routines with positions.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C72C
name: chain_single_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, performing no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C74C
name: dispatch_entity_action_partial
description: Applies action codes four, two, six and ten, plus the call-only codes three and five, to an entity whose flag is set. Code four stores a masked value and sets a state byte, and code two checks an identifier before calling routines with positions.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C770
name: dispatch_entity_action_calls_only
description: Handles action codes three, five, two, six and ten for an entity. Most codes call routines with the entity's position when the flag is set, and code ten sets a state byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C79E
name: dispatch_entity_action_minimal
description: Handles action codes five, two, six and ten for an entity. It calls routines with the entity's position when the flag is set, and sets a state byte to twelve for code ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C7CC
name: dispatch_codes_two_six_ten
description: Handles action codes two, six and ten for an entity. Codes two and six call routines with a table-derived position when the flag is set, and code ten sets a state byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C826
name: dispatch_entity_codes_six_ten
description: Handles action codes six and ten. Code six calls routines with a table-derived position when the flag is set, and code ten sets a state byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C83E
name: call_table_position_when_flagged
description: When its flag argument is set, looks up a table position, calls a routine with it, then calls another routine. It does nothing otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C882
name: set_sprite_flag
description: When a register equals ten, calls another routine if a second register is non-zero, then stores twelve into a byte of the record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C8B0
name: decrement_counter_and_notify
description: Subtracts an argument from a stored counter. When the counter goes negative, it clamps it to zero and calls a routine with thirteen; otherwise it makes a second call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C8D2
name: call_self_as_argument
description: Calls another routine with its own address as the argument and returns. It has no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C8E0
name: adjust_entry_and_set_positions
description: Decrements a 16-bit field of an array entry by four. It then calls two routines with a value and an offset of one hundred fifty, storing the two results in globals as coordinates.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C8E6
name: update_two_word_state
description: Calls two routines to obtain a value and an offset, then stores the two words returned by further routine calls into globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:C95E
name: scan_matched_record_grid
description: Opens a named file and, if it succeeds, walks a list of records looking for one whose identifier matches a stored value. A matching record is loaded from the file, then for each row and each layer selected by a byte, a routine is called, and it returns one on success or zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:CBF8
name: process_script_state
description: Clears a flag byte in a structure and adds a 16-bit step value to a 32-bit position field. When the flag byte was zero it calls another routine four times, and it returns the two input registers combined.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:CC24
name: run_music_script_step
description: Reads command bytes from a channel's sound script. A pitch command loads a pitch from a table, a volume command sets the volume, and an end command either stops or loops the script. A note byte sets the channel's next pitch and volume from tables, and a timer counts the pause down.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:CF40
name: decrement_counter_and_update_state
description: Sets two channel fields to a constant, then decrements a byte counter in a second structure when it is non-zero. When the counter reaches zero it writes two more fields and sets a flag word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:CF76
name: initialize_audio_and_dma
description: Sets two audio state bytes, then writes the sample pointer, length, period and volume registers of audio channel one. It clears a pending request for that channel, then enables its interrupt and DMA.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:CFCA
name: silence_audio_channel_one
description: Clears the low bit of a channel flag byte, then sets audio channel one's volume to zero and its period to two.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:CFF6
name: store_four_parameters
description: Stores its four arguments into four 32-bit global variables at fixed offsets.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D01C
name: initialize_audio_channels_and_state
description: Stores four parameters into paired globals, clears the volume registers of four audio channels and copies four words from a table into globals. It sets several flag bytes to 255, clears a block of state fields, and enables DMA for the four channels with a constant control value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D0D8
name: reset_audio_volumes_and_flags
description: Sets the volume of all four audio channels to zero, turns off their DMA, and sets a global flag byte to 255.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D0FE
name: setup_interrupt_handlers
description: Stores three parameters into globals and prepares two interrupt-server structures that point at a handler. It registers one with the system through the library, sets a vector with a second library call, and then writes to the interrupt enable and request registers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D1A8
name: remove_interrupt_handler_and_disable
description: Calls a routine, then removes an interrupt server through the system library. It disables one interrupt bit in the custom registers and sets an interrupt vector with a second library call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D1D8
name: clear_memory_and_init_globals
description: Computes a global base offset and stores a derived address into a global. It then zeroes a fixed block of longwords, writes a register value and a global into two more globals, and calls another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D222
name: stub_return_gap
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. It is an unreached gap in the code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D228
name: parse_quoted_tokens_from_text
description: Opens a system library and, if that succeeds, splits a text argument into tokens using a character-class table, with support for quoted strings. Token addresses are stored in an array, then library calls open a file and finish setup.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D51A
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies a string into a fixed-size destination, stopping at its terminator or when the count runs out, then fills the remaining space with zeros. It returns the destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D53C
name: append_string_with_cap
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most about thirty-two thousand characters. If the source is cut short, it writes a terminator after the copied text.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D542
name: copy_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the given count of characters. If the count runs out before the source terminator, it writes a terminator after the copied text.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D566
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from a source to a destination, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D576
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Computes the low 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit register values from their 16-bit halves. The product is returned in the high word of the result, with the second operand kept in the low word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D59A
name: perform_signed_division
description: Calls another routine and negates its result when exactly one of the two inputs is negative, so the sign is handled outside that routine. It returns the adjusted result alongside the second input.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D5C2
name: negate_result_when_first_negative
description: Calls another routine, then negates the value it leaves in a register when the first argument is negative. It returns that value paired with the second argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a].adf:fmain:0:D5DC
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls another routine and returns the original second register paired with the register value the call leaves behind.
